<a id="init_screens"></a>
### [`init_screens`](../../../../src/init/init_screens.asm#L21) `$897A`

*routine*

Clears both screens, copies both charsets from $5000 and $5fe8, makes the sprite bar and sets the seven expanded sprites in a row.
